bullets: The limited tier now recommends GLM 5.3 Flash as the default model while DeepSeek V4 Flash stays as the safe fallback when GLM 5.3 Flash is locked.
Freebucks daily compute cap raised from 3x to 4x of Freebucks value.
Premium session users can start up to 5 paid chat sessions per day again after the Limit retirement.
Muse Spark 1.2 replaces Muse Spark 1.3 in the free model picker after 1.3 returned 404 model_not_found on all probe attempts.
Saved Muse Spark 1.2 picks will no longer be rewritten to 1.3 because that migration path is deleted.
Installed binaries still requesting Muse Spark 1.3 are now coerced to the fallback model instead of refused.
End session refunds and pending receipts now appear in the Freebuff session, showing a pending-refund notice and the final returned amount.
CLI model selector now shows a peak pricing chip for models marked as expensive during certain windows.
Peak pricing tooltip names the expensive window and its end time in your own time zone.
Turn limit error message no longer speculates that an assistant got stuck in a loop, it just states the turn reached its limit.
Earn Freebucks link text now reads engage with a promoted post instead of level up for more daily sessions.
Luna model remains plan-gated only at the limited tier while staying available in the full premium pool on CLI and Desktop.
Removed the experimental Level tier system and its constants entirely.
